# A basis told it has more available than it ever brought in.
#
# 100.00 USD is bought, and the file states 150.00 available on it. A stated
# balance is authoritative — it is how a book records sales this tool never
# saw — but it is a statement about what is left of *this* split, and no
# sequence of sales leaves more than arrived.
#
# Unchecked, the 50.00 USD that never existed is sellable: a later sale draws
# on it, is valued at the basis cost, and books a gain on currency the book
# never held.
#
# What this fixture produces: one error, naming both figures.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_stated_balance_is_checked.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
		cost_basis_available: "150.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
